effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Ice-Snow] or [ALYSION] trait card and 1 blue Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. (Rule) Trait: Has [Ice-Snow] Type.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] If this Digimon has the [Ice-Snow] trait, you may change the attack target to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the fewest digivolution cards.
